summary: Iteration 2 — verified all 4 enhancements (admin email change, image upload, SEO/robots/sitemap, lead-notification email) plus all baseline regression tests. 31/31 backend pytest pass. Frontend: NEW admin email login works, Portfolio 'Upload Image' button uploads PNG and auto-fills image_url field with the full https /api/uploads/ URL, dashboard shows lead-notify test inquiries from backend tests.
critical_code_review_comments: send_lead_email and send_password_reset_email are fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task with broad except; consider also persisting send-failures to a small mongo collection so admin can audit Resend errors (currently only logged).

FRONTEND_URL env is used to build the public upload URL; if the deployment URL ever changes, previously-saved portfolio image_urls will break. Consider storing only the relative path and constructing the full URL at read-time.

Upload endpoint stores files to disk (/app/backend/uploads) — fine for single-pod, but in a horizontally scaled k8s deployment a file written on pod A is unreachable from pod B. Pre-launch: move to object storage (e.g., S3) or a shared volume.
No dedup / cleanup on uploads — orphan files (uploaded but never saved into a portfolio doc) accumulate forever. Add a periodic sweep or only finalize on portfolio-save.
JSON-LD in /index.html is hardcoded with the preview hostname; on production deploy update the canonical/og/sameAs URLs (or template them at build).

Login form's loading spinner overlays SIGN IN text and is centred over the button; force-click in playwright lands on the spinner div (no submit). Real users can still click since the spinner only appears AFTER click. Not a bug, but consider pointer-events:none on the spinner so test clicks pass through.
